import base64, hashlib, io, json, pathlib, stat, subprocess, tempfile, zipfile
root = pathlib.Path('products/distribution/sqlite-original-regression-exercise')
output = pathlib.Path('products/distribution/sqlite-lemonsqueezy-fit/package-readback.json')
output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
result = {}
try:
    payload = base64.b64decode(b''.join((root / 'private-lab-v2.zip.b64').read_bytes().split()), validate=True)
    result['archive_sha256'] = hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()
    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(payload)) as package:
        members = package.infolist()
        names = [member.filename for member in members]
        if len(names) != len(set(names)) or any(pathlib.PurePosixPath(name).is_absolute() or '..' in pathlib.PurePosixPath(name).parts or '\\' in name for name in names) or any(stat.S_ISLNK(member.external_attr >> 16) for member in members) or sum(member.file_size for member in members) > 1000000:
            raise ValueError('Unexpected archive structure')
        result['members'] = [{'name': member.filename, 'bytes': member.file_size, 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(package.read(member)).hexdigest()} for member in members if not member.is_dir()]
    receipt = root / 'private-lab-v2-verification.json'
    receipt_bytes = receipt.read_bytes()
    result['execution_receipt'] = {'path': str(receipt), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(receipt_bytes).hexdigest(), 'archive_hash_present': result['archive_sha256'] in receipt_bytes.decode('utf-8')}
    result['status'] = 'inventory_read'
except (OSError, ValueError, zipfile.BadZipFile) as error:
    result.update(status='readback_failed', error=str(error))
result['scope'] = 'Archive identity and inventory only. Consult the original execution receipt for behavior and underlying grants for redistribution.'
output.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'status': result['status'], 'members': len(result.get('members', [])), 'archive_hash_present': result.get('execution_receipt', {}).get('archive_hash_present')}))
